message.ashfall.strongbox.locked: Locked. Find the building's key, or pry it open with a crowbar.
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.name: Name
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.here.tooltip: Use your position and dimension as the zone centre
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.type.tooltip: Which containers the zone claims: 'any' (chests and barrels), a block id such as minecraft:barrel, or a block tag such as #c:chests
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.ticks.tooltip: Ticks after the last open before a container may refill (20 ticks = 1 s, 72000 = 1 h)
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.quiet.tooltip: Nobody may have been near the zone for this many ticks before it refills (6000 = 5 min)
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.no_player.tool: Radius in blocks around the zone that counts as 'near' for the quiet period
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.scan.tooltip: Claim every loaded matching container in the zone
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.refill.tooltip: Refill every loaded container of this zone now
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.export.tooltip: Write every zone to <world>/ashfall/loot_zones.json and copy it to the clipboard
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.import_clipboa: Add or replace zones from JSON on the clipboard (an earlier export)
screen.ashfall.loot_zones.clipboard_too_: Too long to send: put it in <world>/ashfall/loot_zones.json and use Import file
